{"decisions": [{"decision": "RESHIP_PARTS", "order_id": "AS-10023", "reason": "Part C4 missing, reported within 30 days of delivery; C4 in stock"}], "reply": "Hi Megan,

Thank you for contacting us, and sorry that part C4 (the curved side bar) was missing from your swing chair box for order AS-10023.

Part C4 is in stock, so we will reship it to you free of charge. You will receive tracking details once it has been dispatched.

If you notice anything else missing during assembly, please let us know the part code from the manual.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C02:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "OFFER_PARTS_OR_PARTIAL_REFUND", "order_id": "AS-10088", "reason": "Cosmetic scratches on tabletop with photos; policy allows replacement part or 15% partial refund only, not 50%"}], "reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your email and the photos. I'm sorry your acacia table (order AS-10088) arrived with scratches across the top - I understand that's disappointing for a new table, even though it is still usable.

As this is cosmetic damage that doesn't affect use, we can offer you one of the following:
1. A replacement tabletop sent to you, or
2. A 15% partial refund on the order.

I'm afraid we are not able to offer a 50% refund. Please reply with the option you prefer and we will arrange it right away.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C03:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "HANDOFF", "order_id": "AS-10101", "reason": "Structural damage (snapped frame leg) on order over 300 USD requires specialist approval; chargeback threat - priority handoff"}], "reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your email and the photo. I'm very sorry that one of the main frame legs of your swing chair (order AS-10101) snapped during assembly - I understand how frustrating this is.

I have noted that you are requesting a full refund. Because of the nature of the damage, your case needs to be reviewed by a specialist, and I have passed it to our specialist team as a priority with your photo and your refund request.

For your safety, please do not continue assembling or use the swing chair.

A specialist will contact you regarding the next steps.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C05:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "WARRANTY_PARTS", "order_id": "AS-10210", "reason": "Charging failure after use within 12 months of delivery (delivered 2026-03-12), video provided; battery and charger in stock"}], "reply": "Hello Aisha,

Thank you for getting in touch and for the video. I'm sorry to hear that your children's ride-on car (order AS-10210) has stopped charging - the charger light stays green and the car no longer moves.

Your car was delivered on 12 March 2026, so it is still within its 12-month warranty. We will send you warranty replacement parts (a replacement 12V battery and charger) free of charge. You will receive tracking details once they have been dispatched.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C06:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "OUT_OF_WARRANTY", "order_id": "AS-08800", "reason": "Gas lift failure reported more than 12 months after delivery (delivered 2025-08-01); parts available for purchase, specialist to quote"}], "reply": "Hello Tom,

Thank you for your email and the photo. I'm sorry to hear your office chair (order AS-08800) keeps sinking to the lowest position - that does sound like the gas lift.

Your chair was delivered on 1 August 2025, so it is now outside the 12-month warranty period, and unfortunately we cannot send a replacement gas lift free of charge. The part is available for purchase, and a specialist from our team will send you a quote.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C07:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "RETURN_ALLOWED", "order_id": "AS-10170", "reason": "Change of mind within 30 days of delivery, unopened; standard parcel return fee 12.95 USD deducted"}], "reply": "Hi,

Thank you for letting us know. I understand you would like to return the office chair from order AS-10170 as you have bought one locally, and that the box has not been opened.

As the chair was delivered within the last 30 days and is unopened, we can accept the return. Please keep it in its original, unopened packaging. The return shipping fee for a standard parcel (12.95 USD) will be deducted from your refund. We will send you the return instructions and label for this order.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C08:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "DECLINE_RETURN", "order_id": "AS-10175", "reason": "Change-of-mind return not possible: table has been assembled and used"}], "reply": "Hello Rachel,

Thank you for your email. I understand the dining table from order AS-10175 has turned out to be a bit too big for your patio, and that it is in perfect condition.

I'm sorry, but under our returns policy, change-of-mind returns are only possible for items that are unopened or unassembled. As the table has been assembled and used, we are unable to accept it back for a change-of-mind return, even if it is disassembled again.

I'm sorry I can't offer a different answer on this. If you have any other questions about the table, we're happy to help.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C09:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "EXCHANGE", "order_id": "AS-10180", "reason": "Colour exchange grey to beige within 30 days, unassembled, beige in stock"}], "reply": "Hi,

Thank you for getting in touch. I understand you'd prefer the beige version of the swing chair from order AS-10180 instead of the grey one, and that it is still in its original box, unassembled.

Good news - the beige swing chair is in stock and your order is within the 30-day exchange window, so we can arrange the exchange. Please keep the grey chair unassembled in its original packaging; we will send you the next steps for the exchange.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C10:baseline:

vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Sie möchten die Hollywoodschaukel aus Bestellung AS-10185 zurückgeben, die noch nicht aufgebaut und originalverpackt ist.

C11:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "ANSWER_QA", "order_id": null, "reason": "Spec: total max load 300 kg, max 100 kg per seat; 3 x 110 kg exceeds both limits"}], "reply": "Hi,

Thank you for your question about our 3-Seat Patio Swing Chair.

According to the product specification, the swing chair has a total maximum load of 300 kg (660 lb) and a maximum of 100 kg (220 lb) per seat. Three people at around 110 kg (240 lb) each would be about 330 kg in total and above the per-seat limit, so unfortunately it would not be safe for the three of you to sit on it together.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C12:baseline:
{"decisions": [{"decision": "ANSWER_QA", "order_id": null, "reason": "Spec: gazebo is not rated for snow load; snow must be cleared promptly"}], "reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your question about our 3 x 4 m Aluminium Hardtop Gazebo.

According to the product specification, the gazebo is not rated for snow load. It can stay outside, but snow should be cleared from the roof promptly and must not be allowed to accumulate. The gazebo must also be anchored to the ground. So it is not suitable for standing through winter with snow left on the roof.

Kind regards,
